chapters.title: Path into Power Platform, MVP and MCT
Why UX matters in business apps
Customer stories, community and rapid round

takeaways: Start Power Apps projects with a designed UI and user journey before adding data and features, and treat UX as an ongoing process refined through user feedback.
Use Copilot Studio agents for simple information requests and step-by-step guidance, but build an app when forms are complex or users need request history.
AI speeds up low-code development, but developers stay relevant through prompt engineering, verifying AI output and governing AI in the tenant.
hook: Many Power Platform apps work but are hard to use because UX is an afterthought. Microsoft MVP and MCT Tchesco Ayih shares with makers and developers how to design user-centric canvas apps, when to choose Copilot Studio agents over apps, and how AI, code apps and governance are shaping low-code development.
